notes.title: 2021/11/30 Update
notes.content:
1. Fixed saves. Now the save file will be backed up and the game will try to recover it when fail to load.
2. Fixed the damage detection bug. (When an enemy is near a wall, it seems to be invincible before.)

We had some problems with building the mac version. Will take further look about it and hopefully we can update the mac version soon.
